svg.title: Get in touch
svg.desc: I'm looking for a full-time job as a software engineer, full-stack, frontend or mobile. I like owning a feature all the way, from the data model to the last pixel, and Darb is the best example of how I work. If that sounds useful to your team, I'd love to talk.

g.text: I'm looking for a full-time job as a software engineer, full-stack, frontend or mobile. I like
